card.name: Words just before 'concentration' in drug strengths
card.fires_on: Words and symbols right before the word 'concentration' in strength or dilution text, such as 'final', 'a', 'different', or the end of 'mcg/mL'. Seen in vial, solution and reconstitution instructions.

modes.label: Before 'concentration'
